topics.subject: Mathematics
topics.name: Ordinal numbers: first to tenth
topics.description: Name and use ordinal numbers first–tenth (1st–10th) to describe the position of objects or people in a sequence
evidence: Say and read first to tenth in order
Name the position of an object in a line (e.g. 'the cat is third')
Point to the object in a given position (e.g. 'which one is seventh?')

topics.subject: Science

topics.description: Predict and test which everyday objects float or sink in water, and sort them by the result
evidence: Predict whether an object will float or sink before testing
Test and record the result (float / sink)
Sort objects into floats and sinks, and say whether the prediction was right
